description: Coto Laurel power plant solar radiation and power ramp rate data is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Juan Felipe Patarroyo-Montenegro, Jesus David Vasquez Plaza. This dataset contains solar radiation data from Coto Laurel Puerto From May 20,2019 to May 19, 2020. Additional power ramp rate data is provided for seven different methods: Ramp saturation, first order low-pass filter, second order low-pass filter, moving average, exponential moving average, enhanced linear exponential smoothing, and predictive dynamics smoothing. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
